latest_interim.detail: 24-Sep-2026 trading update: no H1 organic % given; 'strong progress' and FY27 guidance of low double-digit organic constant currency growth reiterated, incl. ~5pp photonics premium (photonics ~30% growth). FY27 adj. EBIT margin guidance RAISED to 23.5-24% (from ~22.7%). Record GBP515m M&A YTD (Dreampath Diagnostics EUR279m; Pyxis $200m).

North America not reported (Canada sits in 'Other countries'; NA >= 48%). em_other_pct = APAC + AfNME + Other (includes developed APAC). China not disclosed. US organic growth +26.2%.

claim_checks.claim: One hyperscaler customer ~20% of group revenue (FY2026)
claim_checks.finding: Exact disclosure: 'In 2026, this customer accounted for 20% of Group revenue (2025: 15%).' Sector review: 'approximately half of the [E&A] sector's revenue, or 20% of Group revenue (2025: 15%), representing a growth rate of 52% (2025: 37%)'. Relationship >10 years, co-design/manufacture of optical switches using the customer's IP (Avo Photonics). Note the customer was already 15% in FY2025, so the G3 single-customer flag also applied a year earlier.

Group reported revenue +14.9% (+14.4% excl. Nuvonic one-off); organic +16.6% (+16.2% excl.). FX -2.7%. Acquisitions +2.5% gross but only +1.0% net of disposals. '~8pp photonics' is the photonics PREMIUM (growth above the 7% long-term group rate), not total photonics contribution.

claim_checks.claim: FY2027 adj. EBIT margin guided in line with FY2026 (22.7%)
claim_checks.finding: Superseded by 24-Sep-2026 trading update: FY2027 adj. EBIT margin now guided at 23.5-24% (above the 19-23% KPI range); organic guidance unchanged at low double-digit incl. ~5pp photonics premium.
